components.config_summary: Go standard testing package. Tests are invoked via `go test -race -count=1 ./lib/...` and `go test -race -count=1 -tags=<tag> ./skills/...` in CI; sensors that observe these runs add `-v` so each test result becomes an individually-actionable `--- PASS:`, `--- FAIL:`, or `--- SKIP:` line on stdout. Table-driven tests are the project default.

evidence.rationale: Representative table-driven test using the standard testing package.

components.name: testing

components.config_summary: Go toolchain compiler and vet. Invoked via `go build -o /dev/null ./skills/...` and `go vet -tags=<tag> ./...`; emits diagnostic lines in the form `<file>:<line>:<col>: <message>` to stderr (and stdout when piped). Same diagnostic shape across vet and build.

evidence.rationale: CI runs `go vet -tags=run_computational ./...` and `go build -tags=... -o /dev/null` to surface diagnostics.

components.name: go-tool-compiler

components.config_summary: The harness sensor runner emits one Signal JSON object per matched line (stream mode) plus one final aggregate Signal on stdout as JSONL; objects conform to schemas/signal.json. Carrier of verdict/severity for cross-sensor routing.

evidence.rationale: Where Signals are constructed and serialized as JSON to stdout.

components.name: harness-signal-encoder
